metadata.reviewPolicy: Concept nodes are analytical navigation aids. Mapping relations do not authorize aggregation across source manifestations.

concepts.label: Full immunization coverage
concepts.definition: Coverage of a specified child population completing the vaccination schedule defined by the relevant source and period.

mappings.rationale: Routine HMIS coverage definition uses an estimated child denominator and a source-specific age and antigen schedule.
Programme scorecard manifestation compares fully immunised children aged 9–11 months with children due for immunisation.
Programme scorecard label is conceptually aligned but uses children aged 12–23 months as its denominator population.
Household-survey manifestation is conceptually aligned but differs from routine reporting in design, reference period and denominator construction.

concepts.label: Immunization session plan adherence
concepts.definition: Whether planned immunization sessions were held in the specified geography and monitoring period.

mappings.rationale: Earlier UIP programme record for planned sessions held.
IMI monitoring count of sessions held as planned.
Percentage is restricted to monitored high-risk areas and planned monitored sessions.

concepts.label: Vaccine availability at immunization sessions
concepts.definition: Availability or absence of required vaccines at planned or monitored immunization sessions.

mappings.rationale: Stock-out is the adverse complement of vaccine availability but source timing and vaccine scope may differ.
IMI monitoring manifestation directly assesses vaccine availability at monitored sites.
Reason analysis explains non-availability and is not itself an availability rate.

concepts.label: AEFI surveillance performance
concepts.definition: Performance of adverse-event reporting, documentation, investigation, completion and causality-classification processes.

mappings.rationale: Reported adverse events are an input to surveillance performance but do not measure timeliness or completeness.
Line-listing completeness is one component of AEFI surveillance performance.
Timely serious-AEFI reporting is one component of surveillance performance.
Timely sharing of the case reporting form is one component of surveillance performance.
Timely investigation is one component of surveillance performance.
Completed investigations are one component of surveillance performance.
Timely causality classification is one component of surveillance performance.

concepts.label: Immunization dropout
concepts.definition: Failure to complete a defined vaccination sequence among children who received an earlier dose or antigen.

mappings.rationale: Historical HMIS manifestation measures BCG-to-measles dropout.
Historical HMIS manifestation measures DPT3-to-measles dropout.
Absolute dropout count supports but is not equivalent to a dropout percentage.
Handbook manifestation measures BCG-to-Pentavalent-3 dropout.
Handbook manifestation measures Pentavalent-1-to-Pentavalent-3 dropout.
Handbook manifestation measures BCG-to-MCV1 dropout.
